charts.title: TOI-1203 d: orbits around TOI-1203
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1203's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1203 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gandolfi et al. 2025 (2025arXiv250910136G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GANDOLFI_ET_AL__2025): P 25.502672 d

charts.title: TOI-1203 d: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1203 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (90, 99, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 23434737, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 13 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 25-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min early; 25-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
